description: Twelve reversals for the act breaks. Each lists compatible premise families and two hint lines that must be delivered before the reveal.

entries.reveal: One of the party's trusted allies has been feeding {villain.name} information from the start.
hints: An ally answered a question nobody had asked.
A message arrived at {site.stronghold} that only an ally could have sent.

entries.reveal: The first patron's errand served {villain.name}, not the people.
hints: The first patron avoided one particular question.
The stake was worth more to someone else than the patron admitted.

entries.reveal: {artifact.name} has been a forgery all along; the real one is elsewhere.
hints: The relic felt wrong in the hand, too plain and too warm.
A scholar noticed an anachronism in its carving.

entries.reveal: {villain.name} is only an agent; something far worse is giving the orders.
hints: {villain.name} spoke of 'when I am released', not 'when I win'.
A servant flinched at a name that did not belong to {villain.name}.

entries.reveal: The missing heir is alive, and has been quietly helping the party all along.
hints: A stranger paid a debt in the party's name.
An old family sign appeared on a safe door.

entries.reveal: {faction.a} has made a private deal with {villain.name}.
hints: Their patrols were absent on a night they should have been out.
A faction envoy was seen leaving {site.stronghold}.

entries.reveal: The visible schedule was a feint; the real deadline is much closer.
hints: Two notes disagreed about the date.
The ritual circle's markings were for a different night.

entries.reveal: The only cure requires what the party has been carrying all along.
hints: A healer examined the party's keepsake with far too much interest.
The old tale names the cure as a thing 'carried in friendly hands'.

entries.reveal: The beast was guarding something the villain wants, and never meant harm.
hints: The creature killed no one that anyone could prove.
Its tracks circled the same spot every night.

entries.reveal: One of {villain.name}'s lieutenants will help the party, for a price.
hints: The lieutenant struck to disarm, not to wound.
A scrawled note begged the party to look away from the east road.

entries.reveal: The sanctuary the party trusted is built on top of {site.stronghold}'s true entrance.
hints: The sanctuary's bells never rang at dawn.
A hidden stair was bricked up in a hurry.

entries.reveal: {villain.name} is right about one thing: the region's old order really was unjust.
hints: A ledger showed the old rulers taking more than their share.
Villagers spoke of {villain.name} with something close to gratitude.
